data.long_meaning: The name Hervey is derived from the Old German name Heribert, which means 'bright, famous, bright ruler.' This name was popular in France and England during the Middle Ages. It is composed of the elements 'heri,' meaning army or warrior, and 'berht,' meaning bright or famous.
